definition.text: The son of Lamech and Zillah, “an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron” (Gen. 4:22; R.V., “the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron”).

chapters.title: Of the Two Fathers and Leaders Who Sprang from One Progenitor
